name: Sandhya Ghadei / ସଂଧ୍ଯା ଘଡେଇ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sandhya Ghadei writes in Odia. In her Kabita Live poem “ଜୀବନ ଠୁ କିଛି ଅଲଗା”, tears, discarded clothing and a road with many crossings give shape to the difficulty of living beyond disappointment. The speaker questions whether affection can be asked for and whether anyone can teach the art of living.

Moonlight and the geography of the mind widen this inward journey. The poem’s boundaries and solitary movement leave the reader with the effort of carrying on, rather than an easy resolution. These observations describe this poem’s voice, not a claim about the poet’s personal circumstances.
